decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 85CHR 201 rev A, 85CHR 900 rev E, Location Plan received 12/04/2012, 85CHR 200 rev C, 85CHR(3) 100 rev A received 01/06/2012  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the premises at 83 Chiswick High Road shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Removal of existing entrance door at number 85 replace with glazing, stall riser and cill to match the existing unit at number 83, internal alterations including creation of an opening in the wall between numbers 83 and 85 to create an enlarged retail space.  Erection of a ground floor rear extension and alterations at basement level to provide additional usable floor area
